bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test -d .git || exit 60
new=026842b8d1a5e25d9e26a7c0ab47f75bfacf1e04
git cat-file -e "$new^{commit}" || exit 61
files=(scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_flow_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py)
for idx in "${!files[@]}"; do
 f="${files[$idx]}"
 if ! test -e "$f"; then continue; fi
 test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || exit $((80+idx))
 current="$(git hash-object "$f")"
 known=0
 for commit in $(git log --format=%H "$new" -- "$f"); do
  candidate="$(git rev-parse "$commit:$f" 2>/dev/null)" || continue
  if test "$candidate" = "$current"; then known=1; break; fi
 done
 test "$known" = 1 || exit $((80+idx))
done
echo ALL_FOUR_FILES_MATCH_KNOWN_HISTORY
